test_title: PYST 9: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 11 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: What is the focus of the Scheme of Human Resources Development in Sports?

options.text: Training and development of sports professionals
Building swimming pools for agile swimmers
Construction of gyms in every part of India

solution:
The correct answer is __**Training and development of sports professionals**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Scheme of Human Resources Development in Sports focuses on **training and developing skilled sports professionals**, including athletes, coaches, and support staff.
 
• The scheme aims to enhance the overall sports ecosystem by providing **specialized training, resources, and infrastructure** to nurture talent.
 
• It emphasizes creating opportunities for **young athletes to receive professional guidance** and participate in national and international competitions.
 
• Collaboration with national and international organizations is promoted to ensure the adoption of global best practices in sports training.
 
• Scholarships, financial aid, and other incentives are provided to encourage participation and excellence in sports.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sports Authority of India (SAI):** The primary body responsible for sports development in India. It oversees training programs and provides infrastructure for athletes.
 
• **Khelo India Programme:** Launched by the Government of India to promote sports at the grassroots level and identify young talent for advanced training.
 
• **National Sports Development Fund (NSDF):** A fund established to mobilize resources for sports development and assist talented athletes with financial support.
 
• **Role of Coaches:** The scheme recognizes the importance of well-trained coaches in developing athletes and conducts regular workshops and certification programs.
 
• **International Partnerships:** The scheme encourages partnerships with foreign sports organizations to facilitate knowledge exchange and advanced training methods.
